description: This file implements a gRPC server transport over HTTP/2 using the net/http package, handling server-side streaming, headers, and status management within the grpc/internal/transport package.

classes.name: serverHandlerTransport
classes.description: Implements the ServerTransport interface, managing HTTP/2 gRPC server communication, headers, streams, and status updates.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the transport, releasing resources and signaling shutdown.

methods.name: Peer
methods.description: Returns peer information including address and auth info.

methods.name: do
methods.description: Runs a function in the ServeHTTP goroutine, serializing execution.

methods.name: writeStatus
methods.description: Writes the status and trailers to the HTTP response, finalizing the gRPC call.

methods.name: writePendingHeaders
methods.description: Sets headers before the first data write.

methods.name: writeCommonHeaders
methods.description: Sets standard headers like Content-Type and trailers.

methods.name: writeCustomHeaders
methods.description: Sets custom headers from the stream.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes headers and data to the response, handling flow control.

methods.name: writeHeader
methods.description: Sets header metadata and flushes headers.

methods.name: HandleStreams
methods.description: Handles a single gRPC stream over an HTTP request, managing reading and writing.

methods.name: runStream
methods.description: Processes queued write functions until the stream is closed.
